title: Short Windows, Unmodelled Costs, Unknown Cutoffs: A Pre-Registered Evidence Audit of 91 LLM Trading Papers
abstract: arXiv:2611.18934v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Papers on large-language-model (LLM) trading agents and alpha mining report Sharpe ratios that would be remarkable in any other part of empirical finance. We audit the evidence behind those numbers. Before coding a single paper we pre-registered a population of 91 papers from a curated corpus of LLM trading research, a ten-field coding rubric, an analysis script and five directional hypotheses, and committed all of them to version control. Every code is backed by a verbatim quote that a script checks against the paper's text, and a second, blind coder recoded a random 20%. Of the 75 papers with a trading test, 51% deduct no trading costs and only 9% model costs from data; the median test window is 12 months, and a quarter of windows are six months or shorter. translated_title: 短窗口、未建模成本、未知截止日期：对91篇LLM交易论文的预注册证据审计
translated_abstract: 关于大型语言模型（LLM）交易智能体与阿尔法挖掘的论文所报告的夏普比率，在任何其他实证金融领域都堪称惊人。我们审计了这些数字背后的证据。在编写任何论文的编码之前，我们预先注册了一个包含91篇论文的研究总体（选自精心整理的LLM交易研究语料库）、一份十个字段的编码规则、一个分析脚本以及五项方向性假设，并将所有材料提交至版本控制。每一项编码都有逐字引用支持，脚本会将其与论文原文进行核对，并由第二位盲法编码员对随机抽取的20%样本进行重新编码。在75篇包含交易测试的论文中，51%未扣除任何交易成本，仅9%基于数据对成本进行建模；测试窗口的中位数为12个月，四分之一的窗口不超过六个月。在51篇无法确认测试窗口晚于模型训练截止日期的论文中，98%既未在截止日期之后进行测试，也未进行实盘评估，也未使用时间顺序一致的评估方法……
tldr: 该论文采用预注册方法对91篇LLM交易论文进行了严格证据审计，发现这些论文普遍存在测试窗口过短、未扣除交易成本、测试数据可能与模型训练数据重叠等系统性缺陷，质疑了LLM交易策略所报告惊人夏普比率的可靠性。
en_tdlr: This pre-registered audit of 91 LLM trading papers reveals pervasive methodological weaknesses—including short test windows, unmodeled transaction costs, and unverified temporal separation from training data—that cast doubt on the extraordinary Sharpe ratios reported in this literature.
